about_paragraphs: A general dental practice on Cloverfield Crescent, minutes from McMaster, with four treatment rooms and a front desk that knows most patients by name.

Most of the day is ordinary and preventive: check-ups and cleanings, fillings, and the crowns and bridges that follow a lifetime of normal wear. Patients come from Westdale, Ainslie Wood and the student blocks around the university, so September is the busiest month of the year.

Times are arranged by phone during opening hours, or through the form on this page. If something is hurting, call the front desk — the clinic holds back part of each day for people who are already in pain.
pricing_note: Fees follow the Ontario Dental Association's suggested fee guide. A treatment plan with the amounts set out comes first, so nothing starts without a written figure.
new_client_note: New patients are asked to arrive ten minutes early for a short health form. Bring a list of medications and any insurance details.
cancellation_note: One business day's notice is asked for a change or a cancellation. Missed visits without notice may be charged.
direct_billing_note: Direct billing to most major insurers. Bring your policy number and the front desk can check what is covered before treatment starts.
licence_note: General dentists registered with the Royal College of Dental Surgeons of Ontario.
